title: Chapter 202: The Queen Takes Action To Defeat The Strong Enemy

Chapter 202: The Queen Takes Action To Defeat The Strong Enemy

The shells fired by the high-star Zerg destroyers are faster. After the Queen's precise calculation, they will arrive first and will hit the target at the same time as the shells of the one-star destroyers.

"Pay attention to air defense! Don't let the flying troops rush in!"

The troops directly under the Spirit God Green Department rode on the walking ground dragon mounts and aimed the heavy crossbows in their hands at the Zerg flying dragons flying in the sky.

"Boom boom..."

"Woo woo..."

The explosion of the Zerg's liquid fireball shells and the sound of heavy crossbow arrows fired by the soldiers of the Spirit God Green Department's direct army sounded at the same time!

The violent explosion caused huge casualties to the army of the bear goblin tribe. The evil god's sacrificial team all suffered a more terrifying explosion attack, and the divine protection shield covering them flashed white light!

These attacks did not stop the battle formation of the bear goblin army from continuing to move forward!

A little further forward, the heavy crossbows of the army directly under the Spirit God Green Department will be able to attack the Zerg ground forces.

The army of the bear goblin tribe cannot be passive all the time, and must take the initiative to attack.

Nearly 300,000 crossbow arrows fired by the army directly under the Spirit God Green Department, with a faint light, blocked the Zerg flying dragons in the air!

The dense and powerful crossbow arrows forced the high-speed flying Zerg flying dragons to rely on their powerful flying ability and the Zerg's tacit cooperation to forcibly adjust their direction and avoid the terrifying crossbow arrow rain that was shot on their way.

In order to make the charge look realistic, the Zerg flying dragons rushed very fast and fiercely, and many Zerg flying dragons flying in the front were still unable to dodge and were hit by arrows.

The crossbow arrows with divine energy had strong penetrating power. Many Zerg dragons were severely damaged. Dozens or even hundreds of Zerg dragons fell down with their wings flapping!

Fortunately, there was still a certain distance from the square formation of the bear goblin army below. The Zerg dragons that were seriously injured and lost their ability to fly glided as far away from the enemy as possible, keeping them away from the enemy's attack range.

Everyone's eyes seemed to be attracted by the terrible crossbow rain of the Zerg dragon group and the army directly under the Spirit God Green Department. Even the evil god priests focused on the Zerg dragon group.

The 20 Zerg queens that had already left the Zerg dragon group hid far away in the host group with invisibility talent. According to the information provided by the Zerg host, they silently launched a spawning attack on the ten evil god high priests in the bear goblin army.

Nearly 60,000 huge Zerg flying dragons showed off their powerful flying ability and fierce nature, constantly trying to rush into their range and attack the army phalanx of the bear goblin clan.

"Bang Bang Bang...!"

Accompanied by another round of attacks from the Zerg destroyers, the sensitive evil god priests finally discovered that their high priests were a little abnormal!

In just less than two seconds, two of the weakest high priests "popped" and exploded into pieces of flesh and blood, and something unknown exploded directly from their bodies!

Before the flesh and blood fragments splashed, everything turned into light and disappeared!

"Pop, pop, pop...!"

Seven of the ten evil god high priests scattered in the three spiritual god green army phalanxes, which were relatively weak, exploded inexplicably from the inside of their bodies and disappeared in light!

Only the three strongest evil god high priests in the central army were left, with white light flashing violently on their bodies, and their originally peaceful faces became extremely hideous!

"Pay attention to maintaining the magic shield! Protect the high priest!"

"Boom...!"

The terrible explosion hit the magic shield that protected the evil god priest team!

The evil god priests tried their best to keep the magic shield intact!

In the Zerg host group in the air in the distance, three Zerg queens on standby launched another spawning attack on the three evil god high priests who were fighting against the exploding parasites in their bodies!

The powerful enemy has enough energy and nutrition in its body to cultivate two batches of powerful exploding parasites.

The three powerful evil god high priests could only barely suppress the alien insects in their bodies from exploding. Now they were sucked of energy and vitality by a group of strange alien insects. They could no longer hold on. With a "pop", they followed the footsteps of other evil god high priests!

Originally, these evil god high priests who held the power to change the situation were sniped by the Zerg in an inexplicable way at the first moment of the war!

The other evil god priests lost their backbone at once. Even if they were not afraid of death at all, they were also numb in the face of this unknown and strange attack method.

But they thought too much. The egg-laying consumption of the Zerg Queen was a bit large. This powerful single attack was not prepared for the evil god priests of their strength.

They could not bear the liquid fireball shell attack of the high-star Zerg destroyer!

"Strengthen the defense! Let's protect ourselves first!"

An evil god priest shouted loudly.

The evil god priests could no longer care about blessing the army of the bear goblin tribe. They were now in danger of themselves. If they all died and lost their divine blessing, there would be no suspense in this battle!

"Boom...!"

The Zerg destroyers continued to attack, and with the constant harassment of the Zerg flying dragon group in the air, the formation of the army of the bear goblin tribe, which had been forcibly advancing, inevitably fell into a certain state of chaos.

For a time, no one except the Evil God Priest Team knew that all their senior staff had been killed by the Zerg without a trace!

The Zerg Destroyer launched another round of attacks. The Zerg flying dragons in the air once again attacked the bugbear army's phalanx. Those high-star flying dragons launched high-altitude and long-distance attacks on the enemy phalanx below.

100 Zerg three-star explosive mosquitoes flying high in the sky suddenly divided into three squads, each consisting of 10 three-star explosive mosquitoes.

They started accelerating directly at high altitude, and launched a suicidal dive attack at extremely high speeds towards the three evil god sacrificial teams who were in the army directly under the Green Ministry of Spiritual God!

With the extremely tacit cooperation of the Zerg Destroyers, this time it was no longer a scattered attack, but a concentrated fire attack at the location of the three evil god sacrificial teams.

The extremely violent explosion wiped out all the soldiers directly under the Green Ministry of Spirit God around the three evil god sacrificial teams!

The impact of the violent explosion, coupled with the hot red corrosive slime splashing everywhere, blocked the view of the army below.

This gave the three Zerg three-star Explosive Mosquito squads time to attack, and they swooped over the target's head very smoothly!

Without the support of the Evil God's High Priest, the Evil God's Priest team, which had tried its best to defend itself, was already unable to hold on under the fierce concentrated fire attack of the Zerg Destroyer.

"Boom...! Boom...! Boom...!"

Three huge explosions overshadowed all the remnants of the previous explosions!

The three powerful magical protective shields covering the Evil God Priests' team were broken immediately. The Evil God Priests inside crackled and turned into light and disappeared!

The power of three-star explosive mosquitoes exploding simultaneously is so terrifying!

At the beginning of the war, the various tactics of the Zerg army were dazzling. Relying on the advantages of arms and information, in a few rounds, the true support of the bugbear army, the powerful evil god sacrificial team, was wiped out.

With such results for the Zerg army, Wu Qing was in a good mood. He took a look at the conditions for upgrading the Zerg nest required by the system. The number of four-star creatures killed became 6/10, and the number of five-star creatures killed also increased. It became a 3/10!

This shows that the Zerg Queen just killed a total of 5 four-star Evil God High Priests and 3 five-star Evil God High Priests!

Among the 10 evil god high priests of the bugbear clan, except for the two evil god high priests who were killed by the Zerg queen in less than two seconds, the other eight evil god high priests were all four-star or above!

Among them, the three evil god priests who persisted in not exploding under the attack of the Zerg Queen laying eggs, are all powerful men with five-star strength!

With three-star strength, the Zerg Queen can kill four-star enemies once she spawns, and can kill five-star enemies twice!

The Zerg Queen's egg-laying ability is even more powerful than Wu Qing's expectations. The powerful and weird single-target killing ability, coupled with the ultra-long attack distance, super attack concealment and attack penetration, can really be regarded as a powerful weapon. A heaven-defying ability!

This is just one of the many abilities of the Zerg Queen. Wu Qing now feels that it makes sense that hatching them consumes a lot of energy resources.

The entire sacrificial team of the bugbear army was wiped out. Before anyone could react, some soldiers from the army directly under the Green Ministry of Spirit God suddenly lowered the heavy crossbows in their hands and fired a crossbow arrow at the vital points of their companions!

Crossbow arrows at such a close range have extremely strong armor-piercing capabilities. One arrow can penetrate the green armor of soldiers directly under the Green Ministry of Spirit God!

This kind of close-in attack can cause heavy damage with one arrow!

This is the Queen of the Zerg using her parasitic control ability to randomly control some of the powerful soldiers directly under the Green Ministry of Spirit God, and launch a surprise attack on their companions!

Facing the parasitic control parasites of the Zerg Queen, no matter how firm the faith and strong will of these soldiers are, it is useless. This is a proper physical attack, and mental resistance is useless!

The impact of this situation is unimaginable. Every soldier in the army directly under the Green Ministry of Spirit God needs to be prepared for sudden attacks by his companions. No one knows which companion will suddenly give you a fatal arrow!

The bugbear clan's army has now completely destroyed its command core, and can only rely on mid-level and low-level officers to direct operations. Faced with this situation again, it is even more helpless.

"Maintain formation! Keep moving forward!"

"Don't be afraid of your companions! Whoever harms us is the enemy!"

An experienced mid-level officer shouted orders.
